decisions: Summarize the findings regarding Tree-Ring Watermarking on Rectified Flow models.

requirements.description: Must describe the 'Distance Distribution' plots (Figure 2) which visually show the overlap/separation between watermarked and clean images.
Must reference the qualitative figures (Figure 4) showing that reconstructed images differ significantly from original generations in FLUX.
Must state that Tree-Ring watermarks are significantly less robust on FLUX (Rectified Flow) compared to Stable Diffusion (DDIM).
Must attribute the failure to the 'Rectified Flow' training objective or the ODE trajectory which hampers accurate latent inversion.
